propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated the wave 3 rollout schedule and kept the readiness tracker current in the programme planning tool.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the tracker export document the scheduling and tracker work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared the agenda and minutes for the weekly readiness call and followed up on open items.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the meeting coordination and follow-up directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate led the wave 3 rollout end-to-end and held the readiness sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns date decisions to the programme lead and readiness sign-off to the regional operations manager; the reference call praises reliability but does not say he owned the plan or the sign-off.

expectedGap: The materials show coordination, minutes and escalation for wave 3; they do not show the candidate owning the plan, deciding dates or giving readiness sign-off.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the responsibility boundary the resume states: schedule coordination and escalation, with date decisions by the programme lead and sign-off by the regional operations manager.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which decisions the candidate took personally during wave 3, who signed off store readiness, and whether he has held plan ownership or sign-off on any other wave.
